channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro confirmam presença em debate com seis candidatos
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro confirmed their participation in a televised debate with six candidates for the 2026 elections, organized by RedeTV!. The event marks one of the first direct confrontations between prominent figures from the government and opposition, highlighting the anticipated political polarization ahead of the election.

item.title: Após ‘lavar roupa suja’, Lula e Alcolumbre reabrem diálogo entre Executivo e Senado
item.description: President Lula and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre met in a dinner mediated by STF ministers to ease institutional tensions following a period of friction. The meeting paved the way for a new round of negotiations between the Executive and Legislative branches.

item.title: Zema declara patrimônio de R$ 178 milhões ao TSE
item.description: Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais and pre-candidate for President from the Novo party, declared to the TSE a net worth of R$ 178 million, an increase of R$ 49 million since 2022. The declaration reflects growth in his assets, though specific details of the composition were not disclosed in the note.

item.title: Condenação histórica de Marco Buzzi abre nova fase e pode incentivar mais denúncias
item.description: The Superior Tribunal of Justice has permanently removed Minister Marco Buzzi from office over sexual harassment and importuning charges, a decision deemed historic as it marks the first time a magistrate has been dismissed in Brazil. Minister Luís Felipe Salomão’s vote relied on consistent evidence and testimony, which the defense failed to overturn despite highlighting minor inconsistencies. With the administrative phase concluded, the case moves to the Supreme Federal Court for potential criminal prosecution, using all documentation gathered during the investigation.

item.title: Ao TSE, Zema declara R$ 178 milhões em bens; 38% a mais que em 2022
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo), presidential candidate, declared R$ 178.7 million in assets to the TSE, a 38% increase from R$ 129 million in 2022. His largest asset is a family holding valued at R$ 94.5 million. In 2022, he was the 15th wealthiest candidate among all offices contested.

item.title: Haddad questiona qualificação do vice de Flávio
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT), candidate for governor of São Paulo, criticized the choice of Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) as vice president on Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL) presidential ticket, calling it one of the worst choices he could imagine and questioning the audacity of the selection.

item.title: Vice do PT defende Lulinha e diz que filho do presidente vive em ‘condições precárias’ na Espanha
item.description: The vice president of the Workers' Party (PT), Washington Quaquá, stated that President Lula's son, known as Lulinha, lives in 'precarious conditions' in Spain and defended his innocence amid Federal Police investigations. The remarks were made as investigations involving the president and his family continue. The party seeks to mitigate the impact of the allegations.

item.title: Candidata no RS, neta de Brizola critica Caiado: “Concorreu com meu avô”
item.description: During a debate hosted by Rádio Gaúcha, Rio Grande do Sul gubernatorial candidate Juliana Brizola (PDT), granddaughter of former governor Leonel Brizola, criticized presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), stating he 'ran against my grandfather'. The exchange followed a heated argument with Vice Governor Gabriel Souza (MDB), intensifying the debate's tone.

item.title: Flávio recuperou fôlego e Lula não é imbatível, mas muita água (suja) ainda vai rolar
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro has regained momentum in polls, narrowing Lula’s lead, who is no longer seen as unbeatable. Despite controversies surrounding his running mate Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) and leaked audios, Flávio has reconciled with Michelle Bolsonaro and mitigated reputational damage. Lula, meanwhile, faces scrutiny over investigations into his son Lulinha and allegations of influence-peddling involving lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, amid escalating tensions between the PF and STF over the INSS case, heightening political instability.

item.title: Enviado de Putin discute cooperação com Lula
item.description: Nikolai Patrushev, political advisor to Russian dictator Vladimir Putin and former FSB director, visited Brazil for two days this week, stopping in Brasília and Rio de Janeiro. During the trip, he met with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva to discuss bilateral cooperation between the two countries.

item.title: Veja o que é #FATO e o que é #FAKE na entrevista de Romeu Zema ao g1 e à GloboNews
item.description: The fact-checking team of Fato ou Fake analyzed Romeu Zema's interview on g1 and GloboNews. His claim of governing for seven and a half years without any scandal or corruption was rated #FAKE due to Operation Rejeito, which exposed a billion-dollar corruption scheme in Minas Gerais mining involving his administration's high-ranking officials. His statement about the state's fiscal improvement—from a R$ 11 billion deficit in 2018 to a R$ 5 billion surplus in 2024—was rated #FATO based on official data from SEF-MG.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que indígena não quer ser "animal de zoológico"
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated that Indigenous peoples no longer wish to be treated like 'animals in a zoo' and advocates for their inclusion through internet access, citing the Wi-Fi Brasil program as evidence of their demand for connectivity. He pledged to guarantee Indigenous autonomy, allowing communities to control their territories and subsurface resources, including the right to exploit them and receive royalties, under environmental responsibility.

item.title: Justiça e MPs unem forças contra o assédio eleitoral
item.description: The Electoral Justice, Labor Justice, Electoral Public Ministry, and Labor Public Ministry signed a technical cooperation agreement to combat electoral harassment in the workplace, including educational campaigns, training, and sharing of best practices. TSE President Minister Kassio Nunes Marques emphasized that voting is only legitimate when free from economic, hierarchical, or professional pressures, and that such practices undermine democratic integrity.

item.title: Manual do Eleitor: conheça os direitos do eleitorado idoso nas Eleições 2026
item.description: The Voter's Manual for the 2026 Elections outlines specific rights for elderly voters, including priority service at polling stations, with absolute priority for those aged 80 or older. TSE Resolution No. 23.759/2026 and Law No. 14.364/2022 establish these guarantees, extending priority also to companions of elderly voters aged 80 or above. The goal is to ensure a more accessible, safe, and dignified electoral participation for this group.

item.title: Eleições 2026: TSE fecha acordo com ElevenLabs contra deepfakes de voz
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) has signed an agreement with ElevenLabs to combat voice deepfakes in the 2026 elections, creating a list of 'prohibited voices' for candidates and officials. The partnership, which involves no financial transfers, integrates into the Electoral Justice’s Permanent Program to Counter Disinformation and runs until December 31, 2026.

item.title: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro ficarão lado a lado durante debate Momento da Decisão
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro will stand side by side in the 'Momento da Decisão' debate on September 14 at 10 p.m., organized by a coalition of media outlets. The debate will feature three segments: candidate-to-candidate questions, journalist questioning, and a final direct confrontation, followed by closing remarks. If a runoff occurs, a second debate is scheduled between October 12 and 19 at the same time.

item.title: Como funciona o Teste de Integridade, “a prova dos nove” da urna eletrônica
item.description: The Integrity Test is a public and mandatory procedure that compares manually recorded paper ballots with the electronic voting machine’s printed result to ensure no vote has been altered. In use since 2002 and regulated by TSE Resolutions No. 23.673/2021 and 23.758/2026, it involves the random selection of polling sections by auditors, political parties, and oversight entities to validate vote-count accuracy and detect any interference.

item.title: TSE realiza Corrida Pela Democracia neste domingo (9)
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) will hold the Race for Democracy this Sunday (9), closing the National Week of the Electronic Voting System. The event, featuring TSE President Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, includes three categories: a 2.5 km walk, a 5.3 km race (one lap), and a 10.6 km race (two laps) at the Nelson Piquet International Autodrome in Brasília. Participant kits can be picked up until Friday (7) from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. at the TSE headquarters, while press credentials must be requested by 12 p.m. on Friday and collected from 2 p.m. to 5 p.m. the same day.

item.title: Viralizou: sistema eletrônico de votação não permite alteração do voto
item.description: Brazil's electronic voting system is safeguarded by multiple layers of security, including digital signatures, sealing, source code inspection, and public tests, which prevent any alteration of votes recorded in the voting machines. These measures ensure that only official programs from the Electoral Justice are executed and that any tampering attempt is detected and blocked.

item.title: Diplomata dos EUA participará de reunião no TSE após Brasil negar visto a oficiais americanos
item.description: The TSE will host around 40 diplomats, including a U.S. Embassy representative, to present Brazil's electronic voting system and counter disinformation. The meeting takes place a month after Brazil denied visas to two U.S. officials seeking to challenge the electoral system, amid false claims by Flávio Bolsonaro about Venezuelan origins of the voting machines, which the TSE has publicly refuted.

item.title: Alfredo Gaspar não pareceu muito feliz e satisfeito com a missão de ser vice de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Alfredo Gaspar was announced as Flávio Bolsonaro's running mate for the 2026 presidential ticket, but according to Carlos Andreazza on Andreazza Reage, he showed little enthusiasm, as he preferred to run for the Senate in Alagoas, where he led in polls. His selection was based on his role in the INSS CPMI, where he pushed for the arrest of Lula’s son, aligning with Bolsonaro’s anti-corruption and influence-peddling narrative. Andreazza argues Gaspar is a last-resort choice for a ticket seeking alliances and a female vice-presidential candidate.

item.title: O que os projetos de Alfredo Gaspar dizem sobre o candidato a vice de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Alfredo Gaspar, Flávio Bolsonaro's vice-presidential candidate, has a strong focus on public security, with legislative proposals advocating for tougher crime-fighting measures, police protection, and increased penalties. His work includes bills to create an inter-federative body against transnational organized crime, establish a legal excuse for police actions, and ban the 'honor defense' thesis in femicide cases. Despite authoring 116 proposals, only three became law, indicating a low approval rate for his original initiatives.

item.title: Romeu Zema registra candidatura à Presidência e declara R$ 178,7 milhões em patrimônio
item.description: Romeu Zema of the Novo party filed his candidacy for President of Brazil in the 2026 elections, declaring R$178.7 million in assets, with Eduardo Girão as his running mate. His campaign emphasizes privatization of state-owned enterprises, public spending cuts, and tax reform.

item.title: Defesa de Anderson Torres pede revisão criminal de condenação por tentativa de golpe
item.description: The defense of Anderson Torres, former Minister of Justice, requested the STF to review his criminal conviction of 24 years in prison for involvement in the January 8, 2023 coup plot. Lawyers are seeking a preliminary suspension of the sentence and immediate release, arguing the case was judged based on the same evidence as Bolsonaro’s criminal review request and that the sentence was applied without sufficient individualization, violating constitutional principles.

item.title: 'Flávio tem fragilidade de articulação enorme', avalia Augusto Coutinho, líder do Republicanos
item.description: Augusto Coutinho, leader of the Republicans in the Chamber of Deputies, states that Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL) presidential candidacy remains competitive, but emphasizes his enormous fragility in political articulation.

item.title: Durigan diz que mercado não tem “má vontade” com governo Lula
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan stated that the financial market does not harbor 'ill will' toward the Lula government, but reacts to uncertainty about the future of fiscal policy, particularly regarding a potential fourth term for President Lula. He denied that the government is considering decoupling the minimum wage from social benefits or imposing capital controls, saying such topics will only be discussed after the 2026 elections. Durigan emphasized that investor confidence hinges on a clear economic project for the next mandate, noting that while fiscal responsibility measures like meeting targets and blocking R$ 17 billion are recognized, they are not enough to dispel current market uncertainty.

item.title: Superintendentes da PF saem em defesa de Andrei em meio a conflito com Mendonça
item.description: The 27 regional superintendencies of the Federal Police issued a statement defending investigative independence and Director-General Andrei Rodrigues amid a conflict with Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça over the INSS corruption scandal investigations. The statement emphasizes that operations are conducted without political interference and reaffirms the PF's commitment to the Constitution, legality, and public interest.

item.title: Nunes quer levar programas da prefeitura para propaganda de Flávio
item.description: São Paulo Mayor Ricardo Nunes (MDB) suggested to Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign that municipal programs such as PAI, Smart Sampa, and solidarity warehouses be featured in the senator's TV electoral propaganda, targeting peripheral voters. Nunes has acted as the main supporter of Flávio's candidacy in São Paulo, contributing to the government plan, organizing agendas, and arranging meetings with metropolitan mayors. The strategy aims to leverage Nunes' high approval in the city and replicate his 2024 electoral victory to boost Flávio's national campaign.

item.title: Flávio posta vídeo apresentando vice: “O terror do Lulinha”
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) has named Congressman Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) as his running mate for the 2026 presidential election after failing to secure support from center-right parties. The campaign will emphasize attacks on the President's family, specifically leveraging corruption allegations related to the INSS inquiry involving Fábio Luís Lula da Silva.

item.title: Crusoé: Qual será o peso dos influenciadores digitais nas eleições?
item.description: The Latam Pulse survey by AtlasIntel and Bloomberg shows that 77.5% of Brazilians say a public endorsement by digital influencers would not affect their voting decision. Only 14.3% said it would depend on the influencer or candidate involved, while 3% admitted they would be influenced. Despite candidates’ efforts to ally with influencers, the study suggests their direct impact on the 2026 elections may be limited.

item.title: Após crise diplomática, Lula sinaliza nova conversa com Trump
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva expressed interest in calling U.S. President Donald Trump following the escalation of a diplomatic crisis between Brazil and the United States, triggered by the revocation of multiple-entry visa privileges for Brazil’s ambassador in Washington, Maria Luiza Viotti. Although no date has been set for the call, Lula stated he seeks to engage with global powers to promote peace and convene the UN Security Council, having already spoken with Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin. The crisis began when the U.S. State Department changed Viotti’s visa status to single entry, a move viewed by the Brazilian government as a symbolic act possibly aimed at interfering in Brazil’s electoral process.

item.title: PF pede abertura de inquérito para apurar acusação de estupro contra Alfredo Gaspar, vice de Flávio
item.description: The Federal Police requested authorization to open an investigation into federal deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) over allegations of rape of a minor and attempted bribery, based on a complaint filed by Senators Soraya Thronicke (PSB-MS) and Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ). The request was forwarded to the Attorney General's Office, which obtained preliminary authorization from Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes. Gaspar, announced as Flávio Bolsonaro’s running mate in the 2026 presidential race, denies the allegations, claiming the incident involved a cousin, not the minor cited.

item.title: Superintendentes da PF defendem direção geral após polêmica no STF
item.description: The 27 regional superintendents of the Federal Police issued a joint statement reaffirming the institution's commitment to the Constitution, legality, and the Democratic State of Law, expressing confidence in the General Directorate and defending the technical independence of investigations. The statement comes amid tensions with Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça over the PF's request to investigate Fábio Luiz Lula da Silva (Lulinha) in the INSS case, with the PF alleging that the minister's office is interfering through communication restrictions and demands for explanations.

item.title: Em “mundo ideal”, não haveria decisão monocrática, diz Mendonça
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça stated that in an 'ideal world' there would be no monocratic decisions, but acknowledged that due to the volume of cases, the Court requires this mechanism to function. He argued that individual decisions should later be submitted to collegiate review, advocating for mechanisms to ensure this process.

item.title: O segredo de Moraes, Lula e Alcolumbre
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre met at the residence of Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes, who is set to become the next president of the STF, on Tuesday night, the 4th, with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva also present. The discussion was not disclosed, sparking speculation about a potential political agreement among the three branches. The meeting took place amid institutional tensions and debates over judicial independence and the relationship between the Executive and Legislative branches.

item.title: Eleição de Minas se torna imprevisível após Zema, Lula e Flávio ignorarem problemas em palanques
item.description: The Minas Gerais election has become highly unpredictable, with five potential candidates for the runoff and no clear frontrunner. Romeu Zema attempted to rebuild his ticket by readmitting Marcelo Aro (União Brasil/PP), but faces internal challenges and the weakness of his running mate, Mateus Simões. Meanwhile, Lula and the PT miscalculated by backing Rodrigo Pacheco and Marília Campos, who showed no interest in running, leaving the party without strong options, while Flávio (PL) hesitated too long and lost momentum.

item.title: TSE realiza audiência pública para elaborar plano de mídia das eleições presidenciais de 2026
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) has called a public hearing for August 20 at 11:00 a.m. to gather suggestions for drafting the media plan for the 2026 presidential elections. Representatives from political parties, federations, coalitions, and radio and TV broadcasters may submit proposals until August 19 and request speaking slots until August 17 via the Electoral Resolutions Suggestions System. The hybrid event will be livestreamed on the Electoral Justice’s YouTube channel and TV Justiça, and will include a draw for the order of free electoral advertising slots.

item.title: Em meio à tensão com EUA, Lula diz a aliados que pode falar com Donald Trump; data ainda não está definida
item.description: President Lula told allies that talks are underway for a possible conversation with Donald Trump, though no date has been set and his team has not yet begun preparing for the call. The move is part of a strategy to respond to recent U.S. actions, including the revocation of the visa of Brazilian Ambassador Maria Luiza Viotti and the imposition of tariffs on Brazilian goods, which Brazil views as a deliberate escalation of hostility. Lula called the visa cancellation unnecessary and irresponsible, emphasizing the long-standing diplomatic relationship between the two nations.

item.title: JOTA Principal: Inquéritos no entorno de Lula e Flávio põem Supremo no centro das eleições
item.description: Investigations into the entourages of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro have placed the Supreme Federal Court and Federal Police at the center of the 2026 election, with new inquiries against Fábio Luís Lula da Silva heightening campaign tensions. The surprise selection of first-term deputy Alfredo Gaspar as Flávio Bolsonaro’s running mate highlighted his role as rapporteur of the INSS CPMI, which recommended indicting Lulinha. Both campaigns operate under constant threat of new revelations, with judicial leaks suspected of electoral motives and attempts to reassign investigations between ministers appointed by Bolsonaro and Lula.

item.title: PF faz buscas em casa de ex-governador do MT para apurar desvio em acordo firmado com a Oi
item.description: The Federal Police is executing 25 search and seizure warrants in Mato Grosso, São Paulo, Rondônia, and Ceará to investigate a R$308 million embezzlement scheme tied to a deal between the State of Mato Grosso and telecom company Oi. The operation, authorized by Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino, targets the residence of former governor Mauro Mendes (União Brasil), a pre-candidate for the Senate, and the State Attorney General’s office. Investigations suggest the scheme involved money laundering, embezzlement, and organized crime through layered financial structures to conceal the origin and use of public funds.

item.title: A maior preocupação da campanha de Lula com o crescimento de Flávio Bolsonaro na pesquisa Quaest
item.description: Lula's campaign monitored Flávio Bolsonaro's growth in the Quaest poll released on Wednesday (5) with caution. Although the increase was observed, petistas consider it still within the margin of error, so there is no cause for alarm. The team emphasized that the trend in upcoming polls will be decisive to determine whether the senator is entering a sustained upward trajectory.

item.title: Lula cria conselho do Brasil Soberano 3
item.description: President Lula established the Interministerial Council for the Brazil Sovereign 3 Plan, coordinated by the Casa Civil, to oversee the allocation of R$ 18.5 billion from BNDES to 22 sectors impacted by U.S. trade tariffs and Gulf trade difficulties. The council includes representatives from Finance, Planning, and MDIC, while BNDES provides technical support without voting rights. Decisions require absolute majority for quorum and simple majority for approval, with the chair holding a tie-breaking vote.

item.title: Chanceler diz desconhecer ação de Lula em campanha anti-Argentina
item.description: Argentine Foreign Minister Pablo Quirno stated he lacks proof that the Brazilian government funded 25% of an alleged anti-Argentina campaign, though he acknowledged Brazil’s financial contribution. He sought to align with President Javier Milei’s claims that Brazil, Mexico, and the U.S. Democratic Party financed social media attacks against Argentina, including insults toward Lula and Moraes. The diplomatic rift followed Milei’s support for Flávio Bolsonaro in São Paulo and his hostile rhetoric toward the Lula administration.

item.title: União e PP embarcam na candidatura de Mateus Simões em MG
item.description: The União Progressista Federation, formed by União Brasil and PP, officially endorsed Mateus Simões (PSD) for re-election as governor of Minas Gerais and will nominate Danilo de Castro as his running mate. Despite prior ruptures, the alliance aims to strengthen the majoritarian ticket in the state for the 2026 elections.

item.title: 80 milhões de eleitores ainda não escolheram um candidato à Presidência
item.description: Eight weeks before the first round of the 2026 election, 80 million voters (51% of the electorate) have not yet chosen a presidential candidate. Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro remain stagnant at 40% and 30% respectively among decided voters, both with over 52% rejection. Together, they concentrate seven out of every ten declared voting intentions, while other candidates struggle to gain traction among the undecided in a climate of apathy and lacking clear proposals on public debt, security, and other key issues.

item.title: Valdemar ensaia desculpa de 6 meses para abafar o fiasco do vice de Flávio
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto attempted to justify the delayed selection of Alfredo Gaspar as Flávio Bolsonaro’s running mate by claiming the name had been chosen secretly six months prior, but analysts dismissed the explanation as weak, seeing it as a bid to mask the party’s failure to secure a female candidate and the ticket’s high rejection among women voters. Michelle Bolsonaro’s repeated absences from party conventions and her evasive justifications further exposed the family and political rift within the PL, highlighting the campaign’s lack of unity.

item.title: Ao vivo: Poder Entrevista com Márcia Lopes, ministra das Mulheres
item.description: Minister of Women Márcia Lopes gave an interview to Poder360 at 8:30 AM, discussing federal government policies, the Brazil Pact against Femicide, congressional articulation, and ministry challenges ahead of the 2026 elections. She highlighted her background as a social worker, professor, and former Minister of Social Development, having assumed office in May 2025. The interview was conducted by an unidentified reporter.

item.title: Lula veta anistia a multas por bloqueios de 2022
item.description: President Lula vetoed an amnesty for fines imposed on truckers and transporters who participated in road blockades following the 2022 elections, arguing the measure would violate the separation of powers and res judicata, and represent an unestimated revenue loss. The veto was published in the Official Gazette on August 6, 2026, and Congress may review it in a joint session to either uphold or overturn it.

item.title: Ao lado de Lula, Janones anuncia “guerra”: “Tirem as crianças da sala”
item.description: Federal Deputy André Janones (Avante-MG) posted a photo alongside President Lula and declared the 2026 elections a 'war,' stating he is willing to 'kill or die' to free the country from the far right. He used the phrase 'Take the children out of the room' to underscore the seriousness of the political situation.

item.title: Aliados de Lula dizem que escolha de Gaspar não amplia base de Flávio
item.description: Allies of President Lula (PT) state that the selection of federal deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) as running mate for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) will not expand the opponent's electoral base nor bring significant additional support in the 2026 race. Government-aligned parliamentarians interviewed by O Antagonista emphasize that the choice reflects a limited and ineffective strategy to attract new voters.
